## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: A batch whose findings all screen below the Ground-B threshold makes zero...

The system SHALL ensure that a batch whose findings all screen below the Ground-B threshold makes zero stage-two LLM calls, asserted by a call-count test.

#### Scenario: A batch whose findings all screen below the Ground-B threshold makes zero...

WHEN `screen-fact-check-grounds-with-a-first-stage-judged-pass` is implemented
THEN A batch whose findings all screen below the Ground-B threshold makes zero stage-two LLM calls, asserted by a call-count test.

### Requirement: Ground-B verdicts still require a quoted diff line validated by...

The system SHALL ensure that ground-B verdicts still require a quoted diff line validated by _evidence_line_in_subject_diff; no finding is refuted on the screen alone, covered by a test.

#### Scenario: Ground-B verdicts still require a quoted diff line validated by...

WHEN `screen-fact-check-grounds-with-a-first-stage-judged-pass` is implemented
THEN Ground-B verdicts still require a quoted diff line validated by _evidence_line_in_subject_diff; no finding is refuted on the screen alone, covered by a test.

### Requirement: Protected-subject vetoes are applied in code before any call, asserted by a...

The system SHALL ensure that protected-subject vetoes are applied in code before any call, asserted by a fixture where a protected subject is never sent.

#### Scenario: Protected-subject vetoes are applied in code before any call, asserted by a...

WHEN `screen-fact-check-grounds-with-a-first-stage-judged-pass` is implemented
THEN Protected-subject vetoes are applied in code before any call, asserted by a fixture where a protected subject is never sent.

### Requirement: Ground-A refutations from stage one reproduce the existing prompt's labels...

The system SHALL ensure that ground-A refutations from stage one reproduce the existing prompt's labels on a recorded fact-check batch, with the agreement rate recorded.

#### Scenario: Ground-A refutations from stage one reproduce the existing prompt's labels...

WHEN `screen-fact-check-grounds-with-a-first-stage-judged-pass` is implemented
THEN Ground-A refutations from stage one reproduce the existing prompt's labels on a recorded fact-check batch, with the agreement rate recorded.
